name: 1kg Broken Cookies
ingredients: INGREDIENTS: WHEAT FLOUR, DARK CHOCOLATE 20% (SUGAR, COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER (SOY LECITHIN), NATURAL FLAVOUR), BUTTER (CREAM (MILK), SALT), BROWN SUGAR, SUGAR, EGGS, RAISING AGENT (500), SALT.
storage: STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE AWAY FROM LIGHT. ONCE OPENED, KEEP COOKIES IN AN AIRTIGHT CONTAINER TO KEEP THEM FRESH.
note: MAY CONTAIN PEANUT — 'MAY BE PRESENT: PEANUT, SESAME, TREE NUTS.' The pack adds: 'WE TAKE GREAT CARE TO AVOID CROSS-CONTAMINATION HOWEVER OUR BAKERY DOES MAKE OTHER PRODUCTS WITH THESE INGREDIENTS.' The '20%' after DARK CHOCOLATE was re-cropped at native resolution and re-read to be sure of the figure — in this stencil font the per-cent sign can be mistaken for a Z. Sold under the 'BAKERY IMPERFECTIONS - ODDITIES AND MISFITS' sub-label. No 'Made in' statement is in frame, only the maker's Christchurch address.
